capabilities: Move pinned tabs to the left of each tab group
Re-sort tabs when the layout or active tab changes
Preserve relative order of pinned and unpinned tabs
Keep the active tab active after re-sorting
Apply ordering across split panes, sidebars, and pop-out windows
extras: Relies on undocumented Obsidian workspace internals and may need updates after Obsidian releases; installable via BRAT until listed in the community directory.
intentEvidence: Obsidian lets you pin a tab, but it does not move it.
motivation: The author wants the browser-like behavior of pinned tabs always sitting first, with a predictable order in every tab group.
problem: Obsidian pins a tab in place without moving it, so pinned notes end up scattered among ordinary tabs and new tabs can open between them.

relations.evidence: it wraps Obsidian's setPinned method using monkey-around
Closest to this plugin: moves pinned tabs to the left of the tab bar

summary: Tab-ordering plugin that keeps pinned tabs at the left of every tab group by re-sorting Obsidian's actual tab order.
